title: Raise max_pred_locks_per_transaction 8192->16384 to cut SIRead promotion churn
configuration_cause: max_pred_locks_per_transaction=8192 is the only predicate-lock dimension not yet tested; per-page/per-relation caps are already at their coarsest (0), so the remaining lever on SIRead bookkeeping is the per-transaction lock budget that governs promotion to coarser granularity.
mechanism: r009 proved that coarsening SIRead granularity (max_pred_locks_per_page=0, max_pred_locks_per_relation=0) cut locks_total.p95 by ~83% and GetUserTweets.p99 by ~68%, raising TPS 21-42%. With both granularity caps pinned at 0, promotion is now driven by the per-transaction lock budget. Doubling max_pred_locks_per_transaction 8192->16384 lets each SERIALIZABLE transaction retain more fine-grained SIRead locks before promotion, reducing promotion churn and lock-table contention on the dominant GetUserTweets path (87.6% of terminal capacity). No retries exist (server_retry_ratio=0.0), so this is bookkeeping cost, not conflict aborts.
query_effect: GetUserTweets p99 tail should shrink as fewer SIRead promotions occur per transaction; p50 unchanged since promotion is a tail phenomenon.
expected_tps_effect: Modest increase (0.3-1.5%) by freeing terminal capacity on the dominant transaction class.
expected_latency_effect: GetUserTweets p99 decreases; p50/p95 roughly unchanged.

predictions.rationale: Larger per-txn SIRead budget reduces promotion churn, lowering total lock count p95.
Fewer promotions reduce tail lock bookkeeping on the dominant transaction.
Freed terminal capacity on GetUserTweets raises completed transaction throughput.

alternatives.statement: If promotion is already fully suppressed by the 0 granularity caps, the per-transaction budget is non-binding and locks_total.p95 stays flat.
A larger per-txn SIRead budget could retain more locks and increase conflict detection, raising lock_waiting_backends.max above 0.

why_exceeds_incumbent: Targets the one untested predicate-lock dimension after r009's supported granularity coarsening, with a bounded 2x amplitude inside the safe range and no retry/conflict risk given server_retry_ratio=0.0.

knob_changes.numerical_basis: Double from 8192 to 16384, the safe high bound (allowed [64,16384]); 2x per-txn SIRead budget to test whether promotion churn is budget-bound.
knob_changes.mechanism_role: per-transaction SIRead lock budget governing promotion to coarser granularity

nodes.label: Larger per-txn SIRead budget reduces promotion churn
